title: What If You Stayed Awake for 11 Days?

scenes.text: What if you never slept? One teenager tried it for 264 hours. Here's what happened.
After 24 hours, focus drops and you can't tell common smells apart.
By 48 hours, hallucinations can begin and your immune cells fall by about 37 percent.
By 72 hours, your brain forces microsleeps of up to 30 seconds, and you may not notice.
Teenager Randy Gardner went 11 days awake in the 1960s. He hallucinated and couldn't count backward from 100.
Afterward he slept about 14 hours, then returned to normal sleep within a few days.

description:
What if you never slept?
In the 1960s, a teenager stayed awake 264 hours, and the effects began on day two.
